contact.subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out and our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

faqItems.q: What is included in the room price?
faqItems.a: All rooms include breakfast, free parking, free sun loungers on the beach, and complimentary non-alcoholic drinks at the pool bar. Children stay free.
Yes — Medora Auri is located directly on the Adriatic Sea with a private beach and sun lounger area for guests.

faqItems.q: Do you have a kids club?
faqItems.a: We have a fully supervised kids club running daily during the summer season, free of charge for children aged 4–12.

faqItems.q: Can I book activities (excursions, boat trips) from the hotel?
faqItems.a: Yes. Our reception team arranges excursions to Skywalk Biokovo, boat trips to the islands, and other local activities. Some are included in the room rate — see our current offers.
Standard bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 14 days before arrival. Early-bird and non-refundable rates apply different conditions. Contact us for details.
Small pets (up to 10 kg) are accepted in selected room categories with prior notification. A small daily fee applies.
